title: ActionSheet
description: An anchored list of actions that becomes a bottom-aligned dialog with Cancel on phones.

usage.summary: Offer a short list of labeled actions from one button, with a bottom-aligned sheet on phones.
useWhen: Keep a short list of labeled actions anchored to its trigger on larger screens.
Move those actions into a bottom-aligned dialog with Cancel on phones.

avoidWhen.when: Commands need submenus or should follow the standard Fiori menu pattern.
The overlay contains contextual fields or other mixed content.
